instruction:
On ClinicalTrials.gov, search type 2 diabetes. Filter Study Status to Recruiting, Study Phase to Phase 3, and Study Location to United States. Sort by Last Update Posted, newest first. Report the first three displayed results with NCT number, full title, study status, and Last Update Posted date.

Stopping condition: Stop after all three filters and newest-first sorting are visibly applied and the first three displayed results and requested fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Report the search results returned by ClinicalTrials.gov after the specified filters; do not independently reinterpret study eligibility or conditions.
- Use Recruiting, not Not yet recruiting or Active, not recruiting.
- Use Phase 3 and United States exactly as the displayed filters.
- Preserve the displayed order and do not contact a study, save studies, or submit information.
